title: Question tags (do you? isn't it? etc.)
subtitle: Разделительные вопросы: …, isn't it? …, do you?

theory.text: Русское «…, да?», «…, правда?», «…, не так ли?» по-английски — question tag: короткий хвостик из вспомогательного глагола и местоимения. It's cold, isn't it? You can swim, can't you? Для Present/Past Simple — do/does/did: Anna plays the guitar, doesn't she?

head: Предложение
Хвостик
rows: There were a lot of people,

theory.text: Если голос понижается, мы не спрашиваем, а ждём согласия: The film was good, wasn't it? Если повышается — это настоящий вопрос. Отрицание + положительный хвостик — вежливая просьба: You couldn't help me, could you? You don't have a pen, do you?

items: Let's… → shall we?: Let's order a pizza, shall we?

theory.text: Нельзя ставить один универсальный хвостик вроде , yes? или , isn't it? ко всему подряд. Хвостик повторяет вспомогательный глагол предложения: You didn't lock the door, did you?

en: You're tired, aren't you?
It's cold today, isn't it?
The film was good, wasn't it?
The movie was good, wasn't it?

items.ru: Ты сегодня не видел Тома, да?
en: You haven't seen Tom today, have you?
You didn't see Tom today, did you?
Anna plays the guitar, doesn't she?
Anna plays guitar, doesn't she?
You didn't lock the door, did you?
You haven't locked the door, have you?
They'll be here soon, won't they?
Mike won't be late, will he?
There were a lot of people here, weren't there?
There were lots of people here, weren't there?
There were many people here, weren't there?
You can speak French, can't you?
You speak French, don't you?

items.ru: Им не нравится эта идея, да?
en: They don't like this idea, do they?
They don't like the idea, do they?
You haven't finished yet, have you?

items.ru: Она должна получить эту работу, правда?
en: She should get the job, shouldn't she?
She should get this job, shouldn't she?

items.ru: Ты не мог бы мне помочь? (вежливая просьба с хвостиком)
en: You couldn't help me, could you?

items.ru: Ты случайно не знаешь, где Лиза?
en: You don't know where Lisa is, do you?
You don't happen to know where Lisa is, do you?
You don't have a pen, do you?
You haven't got a pen, have you?
You don't happen to have a pen, do you?
Let's order a pizza, shall we?
Let's order pizza, shall we?
Don't forget to call, will you?
Don't forget to phone, will you?
Don't forget to ring, will you?
I'm next, aren't I?
Mary has lived here for a long time, hasn't she?
Mary has been living here for a long time, hasn't she?

items.ru: Он никогда не был в Риме, да?
en: He has never been to Rome, has he?
Don't tell anyone, will you?
Don't tell anybody, will you?
You didn't work yesterday, did you?
You weren't working yesterday, were you?
It isn't very expensive, is it?
This isn't very expensive, is it?
